distribution: All countries and regions available in Google Play Console
track: Alpha closed testing; production release after this app completes testing and receives required access. No separate open testing / Early Access planned.
accessInstructions: All game functionality is available without sign-in. Mainline puzzles unlock in sequence; completed puzzles can be replayed. Bonus puzzles appear after each group of twenty mainline puzzles. No access credentials, memberships or regional authentication are needed.
audienceIntent: Owner confirmed ages 13 and above on 2026-10-10, superseding the earlier 6+ target. Target 13–15, 16–17 and 18+; no in-app age verification is implemented.

dataSafety.sharingReview: The Console declaration discloses Google receipt as sharing for Analytics for all four types. No service-provider exemption is asserted; Analytics account data-sharing settings were not changed or independently audited.
dataSafety.localData: Progress, undo history, earned hint credits, preferences, detailed product facts and durable summaries remain in private player SQLite. Android backup is disabled. Bounded analytics events are queued separately and delivered to Google; online reporting is not a cloud save.
dataSafety.sensitivePermissions: INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE are required for analytics. No advertising ID, AdServices, microphone, camera, location, contacts or shared-storage access.
dataSafety.collectionChoice: First use defaults to collection enabled; no prompt or public settings switch. A previously stored disabled value is preserved. Declare these data types as required because users do not have a public opt-in/opt-out choice. Required describes collection behavior; it does not mean analytics is necessary to play or prove consent or a lawful basis. Data safety does not itself obtain user consent; assess applicable User Data and regional requirements separately.
dataSafety.deletion: Clearing storage or uninstalling removes local data and stops future app collection. It does not delete Google reports already received. Do not claim a remote deletion feature that has not been implemented.
dataSafety.familiesReview: Owner changed the intended audience to ages 13+; 13–17 may still be children under local rules. Do not treat the age declaration as evidence of consent or a global collection exemption.

collectedTypes.detail: Coarse location derived by Google from network IP metadata; no location permission or GPS access.
Gameplay lifecycle, progress, attempts, completion, timing, assistance, preferences and technical result events; see product-metrics-v1 whitelist.
Firebase app-instance/install identifiers. No advertising ID, SSAID or product-managed cross-reinstall identity.
Bounded technical outcome events such as storage-write recovery and solver outcomes. No Crashlytics, raw logs or full crash stack upload.

contentRatingEvidence.notes: Answer IARC questions from actual final content. Do not preassign an official rating. Colourful liquid is water, with no alcohol consumption. Cosmetic style labels currently include Champagne Flute and Faceted Martini; disclose this terminology if the questionnaire asks about references, rather than assume every rating answer is No.
